objective: Establish WRASAL Visual Artifact Resolver v001 as the provider-neutral boundary between execution plans, renderer adapters, rendered artifacts, and conformance review.
success_condition: One execution bridge output resolves across multiple provider adapters while preserving identical world invariants, explicit NO_PROVIDER_CANON governance, and a required conformance handoff.

evidence.observed_result: One archival laboratory intent produced three execution plans and nine provider resolutions across provider-neutral, generic-image-model, and Blender adapters; all three invariance groups passed.
Every resolution and the aggregate report carry no_provider_canon=true; provider payloads are transport-only and provider output remains evidence rather than canon.
Control-plane validation, conformance harness tests, execution bridge tests, and resolver tests all passed at 705 control-plane checks.

canonical_state_impact.artifact_resolution_boundary: added with provider-neutral invariance and NO_PROVIDER_CANON policy

next_candidate: Render the same resolved plans through real providers, collect artifact observation manifests, and submit them to conformance without promoting provider-specific behavior.
